inputs.kind: actual historical OpenPhenom-labelled raw well profiles; not synthetic and not archived normalized profiles
inputs.selection: Previously frozen 328-compound group_high cohort plus plate controls; no new score-based selection

paper-v11.semantics: Full declared cohort fitting, except explicitly control-only steps; report each declared recipe and codec
paper-v11.reference_status: local CPU replay matched; no independent published reference

strict.semantics: Metadata-first 20/80 identity split, selection/control-only fitting, Raw-only recipe selection, frozen recipe across codecs
strict.selection_caveat: Opposing PA/PC rankings among two candidates give tied zero min-max products; the specified lexical tiebreak selected the recipe. This is not a scientific optimality claim.
strict.reference_status: separately bound local CPU replay matched; no independent published reference

metrics.implementation: Unchanged hash-verified norm_3 metrics.py/io.py from bc4f74838cad1441bd3723b37e4ad78c5cceaa9b

runtime.backend: CPU float64; sklearn full-SVD PCA, NumPy symmetric eigendecomposition

repeatability.second_run: Copied script and lock outside repository; empty inherited environment, isolated HOME, uv-downloaded Python; anonymous pinned metric-source download
repeatability.hash_set_encoding: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping target-relative output paths to file SHA256s

real_data_leakage_sentinels.mutation: In memory only: held-out feature values * 1000 + 99

retained_failures: Two preparation attempts failed in Polars-native Parquet reading with invalid UTF-8/panic errors before metrics ran. PyArrow fully validated the original selected data. The reader changed, not the data, cohort or recipes. Partial preparation directories were retained.
limitations: Two predeclared recipes are not the full 175-effective-recipe OpenPhenom inventory or the multi-model benchmark.
One strict split seed is not the full five-seed production workflow.
The annotation-enriched cohort is a bounded software-validation cohort, not the published evaluation population.
CPU repeatability is not CuPy/cuML parity; comparison tolerances are engineering checks only.
Historical raw-profile checkpoint/preprocessing/aggregation lineage remains unresolved.
No authoritative public full-benchmark manifest, frozen reference bundle, or full MOTIVE input bundle is bound.
At the validation checkpoint, changes were local and uncommitted. Current delivery status is tracked in docs/uv_reproduction_progress.md and PR #11.
